{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk sheath dress in midnight blue, straight cut to the knee, electric royal blue (hex #4169E1), satin weave.
Textured wool-blend blazer, tailored fit hitting at the hip, navy (hex #000080), heavy worsted fabric.
Nude suede pumps, classic pointed-toe silhouette with a moderate heel, tan (hex #D2B48C), smooth leather.

This ensemble perfectly bridges the gap between evening theater elegance and social dress code flexibility. The silk sheath provides a sophisticated foundation that looks polished under artificial stage lighting without feeling overly stiff. A navy blazer adds an intellectual layer suitable for pre-show mingling while keeping the look grounded and stylish. Finally, your requested blue heels tie the entire outfit together with a vibrant pop of color that draws attention to your posture as you move through the lobby."}
